Comber AOI evidence viewer v3

///magnetic.deeply.orbited - WGS84 54.544375, -5.729841 - real Landsat, MODIS, MERIS, Esri Wayback
What is real here: Landsat-7 (2002) and Landsat-5 (2008) are the full satellite scenes from the open Planetary Computer STAC, shown at their true extent (the AOI is the small marked point). MODIS/MERIS are real NASA GIBS images over the exact AOI bbox. Esri Wayback tiles are real ~0.6 m imagery, 2014-2024 only (post-dates the 2005 event). No image here is fabricated; the invalid Landsat "AOI crops" from earlier were removed. Zoom with the mouse wheel; drag to pan.

The 2002-2008 burial event is not covered by any free imagery (Wayback starts 2014; free satellite too coarse). It requires commercial OSNI/LPS / Bluesky / Getmapping / NCAP aerials. This tool shows imagery only - a human must inspect for disturbance.
